title: Coherence Theater
subtitle: How correction gets priced out of socio-technical systems

chapters.title: The Orderly Failure
chapters.blurb: The paper's opening trap, with its real title page on stage: a report stream that stays tidy while the three correction channels beneath it — challenge, escalate, verify — are priced out one at a time. The regime is adversarial epistemic incoherence; the tidy layer is coherence theater.

chapters.title: Five Forces, One Balance
chapters.blurb: The five force pairs of the paper's balance model as tug-of-war gauges — authority vs resistance, incentives vs truth, individual risk vs collective correction, signal vs noise, evaluation vs drift — tipping together into the self-reinforcing coupling loop, beside the paper's real Figure 1.

chapters.title: When the Summary Becomes the Chart
chapters.blurb: The paper's healthcare scenario run as a journey: one fluent summary travels source record → handoff → policy → dashboard → audit, collecting Table 1's named propagation vectors at each hop while its grounding drains — closing on the paper's real reaction-pathway figure.

chapters.title: The Threshold Has Memory
chapters.blurb: An honest hysteresis loop: the marker crosses into theater as pressure rises, then refuses to come back the same way as pressure falls — two crossings, an enclosed area of epistemic debt, and the five mechanisms that make recognition alone insufficient.

chapters.title: The Intervention Test
chapters.blurb: Question five of the paper's field test run as an experiment, twice: the same principled correction propagates and revises the record below threshold, but is documented, overridden, and returned as policy under the regime — with the paper's real boundary-case table as the verdict sheet.
